log_level.description: Logging verbosity level: debug, info, warning, error, or critical.

log_file.description: Path to the HSS log file.

mongodb_host.description: Host address of the MongoDB server.

mongodb_name.description: Name of the MongoDB database used by HSS.

mongodb_username.description: Optional MongoDB username for authentication (leave empty if not using auth).

mongodb_password.description: Optional MongoDB password for authentication (leave empty if not using auth).

hss_fqdn.description: Fully Qualified Domain Name (FQDN) of the HSS node.

hss_cc.description: Country Code (MCC part of IMSI, first 3 digits).

hss_mnc.description: Mobile Network Code (MNC part of IMSI, 2–3 digits).

s6a_listen_addr.description: Local IP address the S6a interface listens on.

s6a_tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for S6a connections (recommended in production).

s6a_tls_cert.description: Path to TLS certificate file (used if TLS enabled).

s6a_tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key file (used if TLS enabled).

s6a_tls_ca.description: Path to TLS CA certificate file for peer verification (used if TLS enabled).

s6a_peers.description: List of Diameter peers (e.g., MMEs) to connect to.

hostname.description: Hostname or IP address of the peer.

max_subscriptions_per_imsi.description: Maximum number of subscriptions (e.g., APNs) allowed per subscriber (IMSI).

default_apn.description: Default APN name assigned to new subscribers.

default_qci.description: Default QoS Class Identifier (QCI) for bearer setup (e.g., 9 = best-effort).

default_ambr_uplink_mbps.description: Default aggregated maximum bit rate (AMBR) for uplink in Mbps.

default_ambr_downlink_mbps.description: Default aggregated maximum bit rate (AMBR) for downlink in Mbps.

enable_sdr.description: Enable Subscription Data Retrieval (SDR) from HSS on demand (e.g., via ULR).

sdr_interval_sec.description: Time interval (in seconds) between periodic SDR updates (if enabled).

send_ulr_on_registration.description: Send Update Location Request (ULR) to MME immediately on subscriber registration.
